prompt: Calm modern fintech product film score, instrumental. Opens with sparse clean felt piano, curious and gentle, single notes with space between them. Then a light soft electronic pulse and a subtle plucked synth arpeggio enter under the piano, a steady build. Then fuller and confident, warm round bass, soft muted kick, airy pads, resolving cleanly on a sustained major chord. Polished, minimal, warm, modern. No vocals, no drop, no epic trailer drums.
lyrics:

[Instrumental]

[Instrumental]
